product_one_liner.value: Bizagi is a low-code automation platform for enterprises to automate and orchestrate business processes, connecting people, systems, data, AI and bots.

pricing_page.notes: Public page describes consumption-based pricing; a quote is required for specific pricing.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows business, product and marketing content rather than qualifying engineering-authored posts about building Bizagi.

public_docs.notes: Public platform documentation includes a Rules API reference and multiple linked articles on AI Agents, AI Workers, Ask Ada and enterprise knowledge.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live opening: AI-First Full Stack Developer (.NET / Angular / Azure), Bogotá. Qualifies because AI appears in the title; it is not a dedicated ML-research role.

model_provider.value: OpenAI GPT models through Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service
model_provider.notes: Bizagi explicitly describes embedding Azure's Private OpenAI GPT service.

compliance_certs.notes: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified; independent reviews found Bizagi Cloud meets HIPAA/HITECH requirements. GDPR is described as compliance-enabling features, not a completed certification.

last_funding.notes: A $48 million minority investment from Invus was announced on September 13, 2017; funding history lists it as the latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round is September 2017, before the requested May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A Business Development Representative posting has an active application link.

launched_6mo.notes: Summer 2026 launched July 21, 2026, within the requested window, adding Kafka event streaming, AI optimization guidance and embeddable Ask Ada insights.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Samir Gulati's profile lists his Bizagi Chief Marketing Officer tenure ending in April 2026, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Salesforce is a documented integration; the BDR posting names LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Outreach as sales tools. Integration availability alone does not establish internal deployment.
